repo.name: mat2
repo.description: mat2 is a metadata removal tool, supporting a wide range of commonly used file formats, written in python3: at its core, it's a library, used by an eponymous command-line interface, as well as several file manager extensions.

readme.summary: Well-structured documentation with clear purpose and comprehensive feature coverage, but lacks concrete usage examples and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: Limited practical examples showing actual command usage for common scenarios (e.g., cleaning a PDF, batch processing files, handling different file types)

injection_risks.description: The filename is not properly sanitized before being used in the os.path.join function, which could lead to a path traversal vulnerability.
The _specific_cleanup and _specific_get_meta methods are not properly validated for potential injection risks.

critical_findings: Potential path traversal vulnerability in libmat2/abstract.py
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential injection risks and incomplete input validation, but no critical secrets or error exposure issues were found.

common_complaints: Feature format support gaps (ODF 1.4+, PDF version changes)
Unintended side effects of options (--lightweight removing links)
Reproducibility issues (PDF CreationDate changes on re-cleaning)
CLI feature requests for usability (file renaming, verbose logging)
praise_themes: Appreciation for the maintainer's work and effort
Interest in improving usability for non-technical users
